style: 2D classic wuxia martial-arts character illustration for a Korean mobile game, premium hand-painted anime cel shading with clean confident ink outlines, mature heroic proportions (about 7 heads tall, NOT chibi, NOT a doll or toy), dynamic readable silhouette, flowing layered hanfu robes with cloth folds and wind, detailed expressive face, warm rim light from the upper left, full body from head to feet fully visible and centered, the figure fills about 85% of the image height, background is ONE flat solid pure green color (#00FF00) with nothing else in it — no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no signature, no watermark, no frame.

poses.idle: Pose: standing ready in a calm martial-arts stance, three-quarter view facing slightly left, one hand behind the back, the other hand raised at chest height with the index and middle fingers together (sword-finger gesture).
poses.attack: Pose: dynamic attack, body leaning forward toward the left, one arm thrust forward flicking the index finger (finger-flick strike, 탄지) with a bright glowing burst of inner energy (qi) at the fingertip in the character's qi color, robes and hair swept back by the motion.

cast.name: 석두
cast.desc: Seokdu: a big, broad-shouldered young Shaolin-style brawler monk, shaved head with six incense burn dots, thick eyebrows, confident grin, brown robe with dark sash, sleeves rolled up showing strong forearms. Qi color: warm orange.

cast.name: 연비
cast.desc: Yeonbi: a slim, agile young swordswoman, long black hair in a high ponytail tied with a pink ribbon hairpin, bright smile, violet eyes, sky-blue robe with navy trim and white sash, light and nimble. Qi color: ice cyan.

cast.name: 청명
cast.desc: Cheongmyeong: a calm young Taoist swordsman, long straight dark hair, narrow focused eyes, serene expression, white robe with pale blue-gray layers and a steel-blue sash, a horsetail whisk tucked in the sash. Qi color: pale sky blue.

cast.name: 반달
cast.desc: Bandal: a cheerful chubby young cook-disciple, hair in a topknot with a cream hair band, happy closed-eye grin, mustard-yellow robe with a cream apron, a ladle at the waist. Qi color: golden yellow.

cast.name: 구르미
cast.desc: Gurumi: a wild young forest fighter, messy brown hair, toothy grin, green robe with a fur-trimmed shoulder mantle and a rope belt, barefoot-style sandals, energetic. Qi color: lime green.

cast.name: 정각
cast.desc: Jeonggak: a precise young scholar-fighter, neat topknot, round spectacles, composed face, indigo robe with golden sash, holding a folded bamboo scroll. Qi color: lavender.

cast.name: 용아
cast.desc: Yonga: a fierce young martial prodigy, spiky black hair with a golden headband, thick eyebrows, cocky smirk, amber eyes, crimson robe with dark red layers and gold sash, dragon embroidery. Qi color: blazing orange-red.

cast.name: 설화
cast.desc: Seolhwa: an elegant snow-maiden swordswoman, long silver-white hair with a white plum blossom ornament, soft blue eyes, white robe with pale icy-blue layers and a cornflower sash, snowflakes drifting near her. Qi color: frost white-blue.

cast.name: 취선
cast.desc: Chwiseon: a drunken immortal old master, gray topknot, long gray beard, rosy cheeks, happy squinting eyes, brown robe loosely worn with a pale gold sash, a big wine gourd on his hip, swaying playfully. Qi color: honey gold.

cast.name: 묵객
cast.desc: Mukgaek: a silent wandering swordsman, wide bamboo hat (satgat) shading his face, long black hair, narrow cold eyes, black robe with dark gray layers and a blood-red sash, a sheathed long sword on his back. Qi color: steel blue.

cast.name: 마교 교주
cast.desc: Demon Cult Leader: a sinister charismatic demonic-sect master, long jet-black hair, small dark horns, glowing crimson eyes, cruel smirk, deep purple robe with near-black layers, red sash, a tattered dark purple cape. Qi color: violet-magenta.

cast.name: 검황
cast.desc: Sword Emperor: a majestic sword saint, long white hair tied back, thick white brows, stern face, golden robe with dark gold layers and a brown sash, a red cape, a long sword at his side. Qi color: radiant pale gold.

cast.name: 신승
cast.desc: Divine Monk: a serene old Buddhist grandmaster, shaved head with burn dots, eyes peacefully closed, gentle smile, saffron-orange robe with dark orange kasaya and prayer beads around the neck. Qi color: warm golden light.

cast.name: 촌장
cast.desc: Village Chief: a kind elderly village master, white topknot under a black horsehair gat hat, long white beard and white eyebrows, warm smiling eyes, sage-green robe with a dark gray sash, a wooden walking stick. Qi color: soft light green.

cast.name: 통통
cast.desc: Tongtong: a jolly heavy-set market brawler, topknot with a white headband, big happy grin, burnt-orange robe with a cream apron and dark sash, enormous fists, rams straight ahead. Qi color: tangerine.

cast.name: 묵현
cast.desc: Mukhyeon (the rival, an excommunicated former disciple): a handsome cold young villain, long black hair, fierce violet eyes, arrogant smirk, black robe with deep navy layers, purple sash, a dark violet cape. Qi color: deep violet.

cast.name: 숨은 자객
cast.desc: Hidden Assassin: a lean masked assassin, black cloth mask over the lower face, high ponytail with a dark red headband, sharp red eyes, black tight-fitting outfit with charcoal layers and a dark red sash, throwing knives at the belt. Qi color: blood red.

cast.name: 쿠비
cast.desc: Kubi: a huge wild mountain beast-master, shaggy dark brown hair and beard, tanned skin, toothy grin, earth-brown robe with a fur mantle, rope belt, very muscular. Qi color: moss green.

cast.name: 로직
cast.desc: Logic: a cunning strategist, neat topknot, round spectacles, short dark goatee, calculating narrow eyes, navy-blue scholar robe with darker layers and a pale gold sash, holding a closed feather fan. Qi color: bright cyan.

cast.name: 무림맹주
cast.desc: Murim Alliance Leader: the supreme martial alliance lord, long white hair tied back under a golden crown, long white beard and brows, imposing stern face, golden robe with dark gold layers, a deep red sash and a deep red cape, broad and powerful. Qi color: brilliant gold.

cast.name: 사부
cast.desc: Master (the tutorial teacher): a wise gentle old master, white topknot, long white beard and brows, kind smiling eyes, slate-blue robe with darker blue layers and a gold sash, holding a long wooden staff. Qi color: pale sky blue.

cast.name: 부두목 흑풍
cast.desc: Heukpung the Vice-Chief: a towering burly bandit lieutenant of the Black Wind gang, black leather eyepatch over the left eye, a scar across the cheek, wild spiky black hair tied with a tattered crimson cloth, smug crooked grin, dark charcoal-gray robe with iron-studded shoulder guards and a wolf-fur collar, thick iron bracers, a heavy chain belt. Menacing but a little comical. Qi color: smoky violet.

cast.name: 사막왕 하르
cast.desc: Har the Desert King: a tall sun-tanned desert warlord with a sharp hawk nose and short black beard, golden eyes, a sand-colored turban with a red jewel, layered ochre and crimson desert robes with a long scarf flowing in the wind, golden armbands, curved scimitar at the hip. Proud and fierce. Qi color: sandy gold.

cast.name: 해적왕 철갈고리
cast.desc: Iron Hook the Pirate King: a burly grinning pirate captain with a thick black braided beard, a big black Chinese captain hat with a red tassel, a long dark navy coat with gold trim over a red sash, one hand replaced by a shining iron hook, a feather on the hat. Loud and roguish. Qi color: ocean teal.

cast.name: 염마녀 홍련
cast.desc: Hongryeon the Flame Witch: a beautiful but dangerous sorceress with long flowing crimson-red hair like flames, golden eyes, a black-and-scarlet layered hanfu with ember patterns, fiery long sleeves, a lotus-shaped golden hairpin, floating flame petals around her. Elegant and fierce. Qi color: blazing scarlet.

cast.name: 알까기 신
cast.desc: The God of Alkkagi: a divine celestial sage, ageless serene face, long silver-white hair and beard floating weightlessly, glowing golden eyes, a radiant white-and-gold celestial robe with flowing cloud sashes, a halo of floating black and white playing stones orbiting behind his head, standing on a small cloud. Majestic and kind. Qi color: radiant white-gold.
